QuestInfo.name: Fantastic Viking
QuestInfo.0: Visit one of the Big 3 attractions, the Viking, at the #e#b#m223030100##k#n. \n
QuestInfo.1: The Viking isn't a ride, it's a fight! Defeat Bearic the White.
QuestInfo.2: Bearic the White has been defeated. That seemed like a weird thing to have in an amusement park. \nGo see Madame Ming, now that you've visited all three of the big attractions.

0.0: There's nothing better than The Viking if you want to test your mettle! Want to give it a whirl?

yes.0: Now get in there, and smash up 350 Bearic the Whites! The Viking's not exactly a ride, so much as it is a big pit full of monsters. HAVE FUN!

1.0: Did you have fun? That took a lot longer that I expected. Maybe you need to train more.

yes.0: I Viking stamped you! Don't worry about where the stamp actually IS.\nHey, you went through all of the Big 3! Go to Madame Ming for your prize.

mob.0: You're not going to have fun if you don't hunt down 350 Bearic the Whites. I say that, because there's really nothing else to do.
